summary: A 2015 meta-analysis of 13 RCTs finds -0.51 kg against long-chain fat, with commercial bias detected and no dose established. A label can't show the replacement condition. One 36-person trial reports better task results in young adults after one dose and after 4 weeks. Coconut oil isn't equivalent to MCT oil for satiety, which matters for the coconut labels on the stop list.
question_for_clinician: Can a dietary-replacement result credit a label added on top of the diet? Agent recommendation: only with that limit printed, and only for weight.
